subject: Invoice issuer & delivery playbook — email vs portal
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who issues invoices? Portal vs email preference

Hi Ben,

Quick question as we finish setup for Acme's Redwood pilot: which party will be the invoice issuer on record? Our AP team needs to know whether invoices will come from Redwood's billing system (PDF emailed) or if you expect us to pull invoices from your portal via API/SFTP.

We have a PO (attached) and would prefer portal delivery (automated pull + web UI) for reconciliation, but we need to confirm two things:

- If Redwood issues the invoice, can you put our PO number on the invoice PDF?
- If we pull from the portal, can you provide a consistent invoice file name pattern and an SFTP endpoint or API key?

Also, what are the VAT fields you provide on invoices for EU customers? We're collecting compliance info now.

Thanks — attaching PO for reference.

Sara Jensen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
(555) 867-0001

Attachment: ACME_PO_9932.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who issues invoices? Portal vs email preference

Hi Sara — great to hear from you and thanks for the PO. Short answer: we support both flows; I'll outline the trade-offs and recommend a playbook so we can lock this for production.

Option A — Redwood issues invoices (PDF email + portal copy):
- Redwood will generate invoices with the PO in the header and send a PDF to the AP contact.
- We'll also push the invoice to the customer's portal (same file) for audit/archival.
- Pros: immediate receipt by AP, minimal pull work for you. Cons: relies on email delivery rules if you want automated ingestion.

Option B — Customer pulls from portal / SFTP / API:
- We create an SFTP bundle or an API endpoint that lists invoices with a stable filename pattern: redwood_INV_<YYYYMMDD>_<INVOICEID>.pdf
- Pros: deterministic, easier to ingest into ERPs. Cons: requires you to consume files (pull) or accept push integration.

VAT & tax fields: we include gross/net, VAT rate, VAT amount, VAT registration number (when provided), and an invoice-level tax breakdown. For EU customers we can include reverse-charge tagging when instructed.

Recommended playbook for Acme pilot (my suggestion):
1) Start with Option A for the pilot (PDF emailed to procurement + portal copy). It reduces setup friction and gets invoices flowing while you validate PO matching.
2) After pilot month 1, migrate to Option B for automated pull if your AP wants a feed (we'll hand over SFTP credentials and filename schema).
3) Connor will own the SFTP/API keys and marissa will track the PO mapping and VAT evidence requirements with you.

I've attached a sample invoice and our internal billing playbook that covers filename patterns, VAT fields, and sample JSON for the API response.

Let me know if you want us to start with Option B immediately — happy to flip the switch.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_invoice_sample.pdf; billing_playbook_v1.xlsx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Who issues invoices? Portal vs email preference

Ben / Marissa — quick operational notes so we can execute Ben's recommended playbook: 

- If we start with Option A (Redwood-issued), I'll schedule invoice emission on the 1st of the month for usage cut on the 25th; we'll include PO as 'Customer PO' field and the Acme VAT ID in the 'Tax ID' field.
- For Option B we'll provision an SFTP user scoped to a single prefix and rotate credentials 30 days after go-live. Filename pattern: redwood_INV_YYYYMMDD_INV####.pdf (we can map to your ERP ingest).
- I'll prepare a minimal onboarding checklist for Acme: AP email whitelist, sample SFTP client config, and an example mapping doc for your ERPs.

Marissa — can you confirm the legal name and VAT number from the onboarding form so invoices have the correct billing address? Once we have that I'll draft the pilot invoice and send to Sara.

Connor O'Brien
Billing Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
